comment.text: H3C10 K37 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bladder tumors; Head and neck tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: headandneck; Lung tumors; Skin tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting H3C10 residue K37 have been observed in skin tumors, lung tumors, and bladder tumors. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
